subjects.description: Existing road traffic in real front-facing driving footage.
subjects.appearance_details: Preserve the real Hyundai front-camera scene, exact camera trajectory, field of view, horizon, perspective, lane layout, barriers, buildings, trees, Chinese signage, all vehicles and their original motion and identity. Keep the existing white ego-vehicle hood at the bottom exactly in place, with the same shape, size and position; do not remove or enlarge it. Transform only the weather into steady moderate daytime rain captured by a real automotive camera with a short exposure. Convey increased rainfall through frequent fine droplets, wetter surfaces and soft overcast lighting, without exaggerated rain lines. Airborne droplets are more frequent and clearly present but remain tiny, short and low-contrast, with natural depth-dependent visibility rather than long bright streaks. No long bright vertical or diagonal streaks, dense parallel lines, uniform rain curtains, or full-frame precipitation overlays. Preserve unobscured distant buildings and traffic. Asphalt is visibly wet and darker, with shallow puddles and subdued physically plausible reflections of nearby vehicles, lane markings, barriers and buildings. Preserve readable lane markings. Moving tires produce noticeable localized contact spray and a light trailing water mist near the road, not dense clouds. Vegetation stays green. Use soft overcast daylight and retain clear visibility and sharp scene detail. Keep the camera lens clear: no foreground water drops, new windshield wipers, glass smears or raindrop overlays. No snow or ice. Rain, surface wetness and reflections remain temporally coherent.
